DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teacher_dialog_job WHERE teacher_turn_schema_version = 2)
       OR (to_regclass('teacher_dialog_turn_cursor') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teacher_dialog_turn_cursor))
       OR (to_regclass('teacher_dialog_turn_proof') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teacher_dialog_turn_proof))
       OR (to_regclass('teacher_dialog_turn_outcome') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teacher_dialog_turn_outcome)) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'refusing migration 017 down: dense turn evidence exists';
    END IF;
END $$;

ALTER TABLE teacher_dialog_job
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS teacher_dialog_job_outcome_fk,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS teacher_dialog_job_proof_fk,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS teacher_dialog_job_delivered_alias_check,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS teacher_dialog_job_failed_no_effect_fields_check,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS teacher_dialog_job_shape_check,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS teacher_dialog_job_response_body_check,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS teacher_dialog_job_inactive_lease_check,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS teacher_dialog_job_status_lease_check,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS teacher_dialog_job_status_check,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS teacher_dialog_job_reconciliation_state_check,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS teacher_dialog_job_terminal_outcome_check,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS teacher_dialog_job_dense_sequence_key,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS teacher_dialog_job_turn_sequence_check,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS teacher_dialog_job_turn_schema_check;

DROP TABLE teacher_dialog_turn_outcome;
DROP TABLE teacher_dialog_turn_proof;
DROP TABLE teacher_dialog_turn_cursor;

ALTER TABLE teacher_dialog_job
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS teacher_dialog_job_teacher_job_id_key,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS teacher_dialog_job_teacher_job_event_key;

ALTER TABLE teacher_dialog_job
    DROP COLUMN teacher_response_message_id,
    DROP COLUMN recoverable_outcome_id,
    DROP COLUMN no_effect_proof_id,
    DROP COLUMN reconciliation_state,
    DROP COLUMN terminal_outcome,
    DROP COLUMN ai_execution_id,
    DROP COLUMN student_command_id,
    DROP COLUMN action_receipt_id,
    DROP COLUMN causation_id,
    DROP COLUMN correlation_id,
    DROP COLUMN canonical_student_message_id,
    DROP COLUMN dialog_causation_id,
    DROP COLUMN teacher_turn_sequence,
    DROP COLUMN teacher_turn_schema_version,
    DROP COLUMN teacher_job_id;

ALTER TABLE teacher_dialog_job
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_dialog_job_status_check
        CHECK (status IN ('queued', 'processing', 'delivery_pending', 'delivered', 'blocked')),
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_dialog_job_status_lease_check
        CHECK ((status = 'processing') = (claim_token IS NOT NULL AND locked_by IS NOT NULL AND locked_until IS NOT NULL)),
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_dialog_job_inactive_lease_check
        CHECK (status = 'processing' OR (claim_token IS NULL AND locked_by IS NULL AND locked_until IS NULL)),
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_dialog_job_response_body_check
        CHECK (response_body IS NULL OR (btrim(response_body) <> '' AND octet_length(response_body) <= 48000)),
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_dialog_job_shape_check
        CHECK (
            (status = 'queued' AND decision_id IS NULL AND response_body IS NULL AND delivered_message_id IS NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL)
            OR
            (status = 'processing' AND delivered_message_id IS NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL
                AND ((decision_id IS NULL AND response_body IS NULL) OR (decision_id IS NOT NULL AND response_body IS NOT NULL)))
            OR
            (status = 'delivery_pending' AND decision_id IS NOT NULL AND response_body IS NOT NULL
                AND delivered_message_id IS NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL)
            OR
            (status = 'delivered' AND decision_id IS NOT NULL AND response_body IS NULL
                AND delivered_message_id IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND error_code IS NULL)
            OR
            (status = 'blocked' AND response_body IS NULL AND delivered_message_id IS NULL
                AND delivered_at IS NULL AND error_code IS NOT NULL)
        );
